title: Make constitution.ng yours.
intro: Manage your account, reading preferences and saved research.

guest.body: You're browsing as a guest. You can ask questions and save sections without an account.
guest.signInBenefit: Sign in to keep your conversations and saved sections on every device. Anything you've saved here comes with you.

reading.title: Reading and asking
reading.enterToSendHint: Use Shift+Enter for a new line. Ctrl/Cmd+Enter always sends.
reading.followLatestHint: Scroll to new messages while you're near the end of the chat.
reading.openSourcesHint: On desktop, open the first linked source after an explanation finishes.
reading.syncedToAccount: These preferences follow your account to any device.
reading.savedOnBrowser: These preferences are saved on this browser.

language.title: Language
language.official: Official wording of the Constitution and other laws always stays in English.
language.savedOnBrowser: Your language is saved on this browser.

privacy.title: Privacy and research
privacy.keptInAccount: Saved sections and preferences are kept in your account.
privacy.keptOnBrowser: Saved sections and preferences stay on this browser.
privacy.retention: Drafts stay in this tab until it closes. Conversations are kept with your account, or with this browser for 30 days if you're a guest.
privacy.provider: When explanations are enabled, your question and relevant constitutional text are sent to DeepSeek to write and check the answer. Avoid including personal details you don't need to share.
privacy.exportFirst: Export your bookmarks, preferences and available conversations before clearing local research. Source editions and citations are kept in the export.
privacy.readMore: Read how we handle your data

data.title: Your account data
data.downloadBody: A copy of everything your account holds: your profile, saved sections, preferences, and every conversation with its messages.
data.adminCannotDelete: Administrator accounts can't delete themselves. Ask another administrator to remove this account.
data.deleteBody: This permanently deletes your account, your conversations, saved sections and preferences. Download your data first if you want a copy.
data.confirmBody: Your account, conversations, saved sections and preferences will be deleted for good. This can't be undone.

clear.title: Clear local bookmarks and drafts?
clear.body: This removes your bookmarks from this browser and drafts from this tab. Your account and saved conversations stay available. Export your research first if you want a copy.

errors.saveFailed: Your browser couldn't save these preferences. Please try again.
errors.exportFailed: Your research could not be fully exported. Check your connection and try again.
errors.clearFailed: Some local research could not be cleared. Please check your browser storage.

profile.title: User Information
profile.confirmNewEmail: Check the new email address to confirm the change.

verify.title: Confirm your email address
verify.body: We sent a link to {{email}}. Your saved sections and conversations start syncing once it's confirmed.
verify.sentTo: We sent a new link to {{email}}.
verify.sent: We sent a new link to your email.
